subject: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barton <alex@granitehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday — really appreciated the rundown of the evaluation goals. Per our conversation, I tried to capture a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a light evaluation cadence to keep Granite Health on a tight 6–8 week close window.

Attachments: Granite-MAP-template-v1.gdoc, Eval-Cadence-slides-v1.gslides (short stubs attached)

High-level asks in the doc:
- Success criteria: 3 concrete business KPIs to validate in pilot (cost reduction per claim, latency on critical inference path, false-positive rate on reranking)
- Shared milestones: demo & integration, pilot dataset delivery, pilot run, quality review, executive review
- Owner assignments: Redwood, Granite engineering, and product stakeholders

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min workshop to align owners and confirm success criteria — are you available next Tue (4/14) 10:00–10:30 PT?
2) You and your security/ops team can drop any compliance questions into the "Security" section of the doc; we’ll add answers and evidence links.
3) We’ll produce an updated MAP within 48 hours after the workshop and lock a pilot window.

Please review the attached MAP template and slides and flag any obvious gaps. If there are security or procurement constraints up front, call them out so we can make them explicit in the timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Granite-MAP-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), Eval-Cadence-slides-v1.gslides (Slides stub)

From: Alex Barton <alex@granitehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@granitehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence

Hannah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. This looks useful as a template. A few immediate notes from our side:

- Success criteria: can we add an explicit SLA target for 95th percentile latency (we generally measure 95th p95) and a representative baseline so we can show delta?
- Timeline: 6–8 weeks is fine but we’ll need a 2-week buffer after pilot for procurement review if finance/legal has edits. Can you show a version that includes procurement gating?
- Security: Priya (cc'd) will send a short questionnaire — attaching a working copy. Can you add a column in the MAP for "security owner / artifact" so we can link evidence (SOC2, egress controls, data retention)?

Also for the workshop, Tue 4/14 10 PT works for me and Priya. Would prefer if you invite an engineering lead from Redwood (to confirm integration approach).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Barton
Head of AI Product, Granite Health
alex@granitehealth.com

---
Attachment: security_questions.xlsx (prospect security questionnaire stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence

Hannah / Marissa —

Saw Alex's notes. Quick internal: please add a "production readiness" column to the MAP to capture infra requirements (networking/VPC, KMS integration, model quantization profile) and an explicit procurement gating row. I recommend we pre-fill the typical Azure/AWS egress and KMS notes so legal has fewer back-and-forths.

Also I'll join the Tue workshop and can bring a short checklist for the pilot run.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barton <alex@granitehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@granitehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 07:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — incorporated the asks into the doc and added two things per Rishi's note: a) a "production readiness" column, and b) a procurement gating row that makes the 2-week finance/legal buffer explicit. I also added a P95 latency target line and left the baseline row blank for your team to fill (we can pull sample telemetry during integration).

Updated files:
- MAP doc (live): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-granite-map-draft
- Eval cadence slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/4d5e6f-eval-cadence

I've pre-filled the security owner column with Priya as suggested and created a placeholder evidence link (we'll replace with SOC2/HSM notes once you confirm).

Workshop invite: Tue 14 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PT — invite sent (Zoom link in calendar). Attendees: Hannah (SE), Rishi (Solutions), Marissa (CS), Alex (Product), Priya (Security).

Immediate next steps:
- Priya: paste the security questionnaire answers into the doc under the Security section before the workshop.
- Alex: add baseline telemetry where possible (optional pre-read).
- Redwood: we will produce a second draft of the MAP within 24 hours after the workshop that includes assigned owners, a pilot run checklist, and a target date range for the pilot.

Thanks all — see you on Tuesday.

— Hannah

From: Alex Barton <alex@granitehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@granitehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation cadence — initial MAP draft and proposed close cadence

Thanks — invite received and security questionnaire is in progress. Priya will drop answers into the doc this afternoon. Looking forward to the workshop and to a short, actionable MAP we can present at our internal steering committee next week.

A couple of small asks for the post-workshop draft: please include a 1-slide exec summary in the slides pack that states the ask and the proposed financial/VP-level impact (high level). If you can pre-populate a placeholder, we'll iterate on it during the pilot.

Appreciate the speed — see you at 10.

Best,
Alex
